question: Can full feature covariance retain weak distributed stock signal that sparse static gates discarded, without the noise cost of reset-driven plasticity?

diagnosis.observed: Static sparse v3/v4 nearly abstained and lost to linear Adam in all six scored real temporal blocks. Switching variants accumulated large prediction energy on real and random-sign targets.
diagnosis.hypothesis_not_yet_fact: Correlated lagged stock channels and weak distributed signal favor joint dense shrinkage rather than marginal inclusion tests. Cross-feature uncertainty should route each observed residual through the full inverse information matrix.
diagnosis.not_a_claim: Dense conjugate regression is established mathematics, not a claimed novel universal optimizer or global stock optimum. This experiment tests the missing mechanism under explicit assumptions.

method.name: CorrelatedNIG v5
method.conditional_model: y|w,sigma2 ~ Normal(x'w,sigma2); w|sigma2 ~ Normal(0,tau I sigma2); sigma2 ~ inverseGamma(2,1).
method.forecast_then_update: u=P*x, s=1+x'u, mu=x'm. Current forecast uses only past posterior. After observing y, m+=u*(y-mu)/s, P-=u*u'/s, beta+=(y-mu)^2/(2*s), alpha+=1/2.
method.geometry: P=(tau^-1 I + sum past x*x')^-1; dense offdiagonals transfer credit across correlated features, including a coordinate whose current x_i is zero. No independent coordinate reset or support gating.
method.scale: Exact conjugate unknown shared variance under stationary Gaussian assumptions. True Student-t marginal predictive evidence, not an EMA residual scale mislabeled irreducible noise. Model can still be misspecified on financial heteroskedasticity/heavy tails.
method.precision: FP32 means/covariances, TF32 disabled; FP64 scalar scale/evidence arithmetic for weak signal and stable log-gamma differences. Complete-state CUDA graph capture, no per-update host synchronization.
method.primary: dense expert selected by real prefix prequential squared error, then fixed prior choice while continuing online learning
method.secondary: static exact-under-model Bayesian predictive mixture of all dense priors and zero, with initial prior mass0.5 on zero and0.5 divided among dense models
method.ablation: diagonal posterior projection after each otherwise identical update, its own prefix-selected prior on the same five-value grid
method.excluded: No discount, injected process diffusion, restart schedule, robust-current-residual multiplier, sparse support gate, suffix-selected prediction blend or changed stock feature pipeline.

evaluation.data: Original SPY 5-minute stock_stream defaults and full file, seed1. Same224 features, trailing normalization and clipping, forecast after intervening normalization bar before target.
evaluation.reason_for_boundary: Previous transfer consumed exactly163840 observations. Fit/select on this entire already-evaluated prefix and score the forward extension. Older benchmark summaries included the whole file, so do not call this a pristine never-seen market dataset.
evaluation.baselines: Independently trained same-class zero-initialized linear Adam and original seed1 hidden64 MLP Adam, both own LR selected on same real prefix; also always-zero prediction.
evaluation.null: Independent Rademacher signs rng1 preserve each actual target magnitude. Real prefix locks for dense/diagonal prior and both Adam LRs transfer unchanged; all learner states start fresh.
evaluation.selection_barrier: Durable lock at163840 before any later label update; same consumed prefix, same noisy loss criterion for all selected candidates. Bayesian mixture is fixed algorithm, not selected on suffix.
evaluation.primary_metric: Observed chronological suffix sum squared prelabel prediction error divided by sum squared target. Paired differences against both selected Adam baselines and diagonal ablation, all on identical consumed labels.
evaluation.additional_evidence: Prediction energy, target-prediction cross term, 8192-observation temporal blocks, selected prior and effective degrees of freedom. Report every candidate and secondary, do not promote a hindsight winner.
evaluation.success: Primary must beat matched linear Adam AND zero on the fixed forward real window. Lower error than matched diagonal supports the covariance mechanism. Null behavior and time-block consistency determine whether any observed improvement is robust enough to investigate further, not a significance certificate.
evaluation.failure: Losing matched linear Adam or merely matching zero rejects a claimed predictive advance; diagnose from covariance/evidence rather than retuning on the just-observed suffix. No unpruned rerun of a plateau to manufacture success.

resources.autocull: Default-on, suffix-local, exactly two candidates: prefix-selected dense and fixed Bayesian mixture. Diagonal/Adam/unselected dense models cannot protect a failed candidate. Median3, EMA8192 half-life,16384 warmup,3 stale evaluations and4096 minimum cadence. Error-ratio min_delta1e-4; null also prediction-energy min_delta1e-4. Save consumed artifacts before exit75.
